title: Cohesion analysis wants reference COUNTS per symbol, not full capture payloads
wanted_capability: A counting/aggregation mode on code.query (or a dedicated code.references) that returns per-symbol reference counts and the files they live in, without materializing every full Span. probe-dash-1 was doing exactly the right god-class cohesion analysis — counting where each field is used across the repo to tell a real concern from a forwarded-field false seam — but the only tool for it returns full capture payloads, which is both wasteful (it wanted counts) and what drove the isolate OOM. A count-mode would make cross-repo cohesion analysis cheap and bounded, and is the natural substrate for porting the extract_java_class_cohesive_clusters analysis as a binding.
fallback_used: Agent fanned out full-payload queries across the repo (and OOM'd before the cap).
